names.zh-CN: Stevens–Johnson 综合征与中毒性表皮坏死松解症
names.en: Stevens–Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis

text.zh-CN:
SJS/TEN 是累及皮肤及黏膜的严重反应，需要住院处理。

- SJS、重叠型和 TEN 是同一疾病谱的不同范围，不是三种互不相关的病。
- 临床常按脱离或可脱离表皮占体表面积分类：SJS 少于 10%，重叠型 10%–30%，TEN 超过 30%；不是把所有发红皮肤都算进去，也不能等面积扩大才就医。
text.en:
SJS/TEN is a severe skin and mucosal reaction requiring hospital care.

- SJS, overlap disease and TEN form one spectrum.
- Common clinical categories use detached or detachable skin: SJS <10%, overlap 10–30%, TEN >30%. Redness alone is not counted; seek care before extensive peeling.

text.zh-CN:
病因评估围绕用药和感染时间线。

- 成人多与药物相关；一些抗癫痫药、抗生素、别嘌醇等可触发，但多数服用者不会发生。
- 儿童还需考虑感染相关黏膜反应；药源性 SJS、TEN 或重叠型必须另核致病药物，不能仅因同时在用药就确认。
text.en:
Assessment centres on medicine and infection timelines.

- Medicines often trigger adult disease, including some antiseizure medicines, antibiotics and allopurinol; most users do not develop it.
- Children also need assessment for infection-associated mucosal reactions. Drug-induced SJS, TEN or overlap requires culprit assessment, not merely concurrent medicine use.

text.zh-CN:
痛性皮疹伴黏膜损伤是急症线索。

- 皮疹迅速扩散、起疱或脱皮，尤其伴发热、口腔或眼睛疼痛时，立即到急诊；呼吸困难、喉紧或难以说话时呼叫当地急救。
- 眼痛、怕光、视力下降，或口腔糜烂到不能吞咽、排尿困难，也要马上向急诊团队报告；皮肤面积小不能排除严重黏膜受累。
text.en:
Painful rash with mucosal injury is an emergency clue.

- Seek emergency care for rapidly spreading, blistering or peeling rash, especially with fever or painful mouth or eyes. Call emergency services for breathing difficulty, throat tightness or trouble speaking.
- Report eye pain, light sensitivity, visual change, inability to swallow or difficult urination immediately; limited skin involvement does not exclude serious mucosal injury.

text.zh-CN:
尽快交接资料，避免延误治疗。

- 带上当前及近期停用的处方药、非处方药和补充剂清单，说明开始、加量和出疹时间；由急诊团队立即评估并停用可疑致病药。
- 治疗不必等到确定是哪一种药引起；医生会根据药物时间线和皮肤活检等资料逐步判断，同时处理疼痛、体液和器官风险。
text.en:
Share essential information without delaying treatment.

- Bring current and recently stopped medicines, including nonprescription products, and their start/change dates. The emergency team must promptly assess and stop suspected culprit medicines.
- Treatment need not wait for identification of the exact drug. The team assesses the timeline and biopsy while addressing pain, fluids and organ risks.

text.zh-CN:
医生结合检查和病程确定诊断及严重程度。

- 皮肤活检可帮助确认和排除其他起疱病；血液检查用于评估器官、感染和体液问题，不能靠一项血检独立确诊。
- 病程仍在发展时分类可能改变；医生反复检查脱皮范围及眼、口和生殖泌尿黏膜，而非让患者自行摩擦皮肤测试。
text.en:
Clinicians combine examination and history to establish diagnosis and severity.

- Biopsy helps confirm the diagnosis and exclude other blistering diseases; blood tests assess organs, infection and fluid status, not a single diagnostic marker.
- The category may change as disease evolves; clinicians reassess skin loss and eyes, mouth and genital/urinary mucosa rather than asking patients to rub their skin to test it.

text.zh-CN:
不是所有药疹或口腔溃疡都属于 SJS/TEN。

- 多形红斑、感染反应性黏膜皮疹（RIME）、葡萄球菌烫伤样皮肤综合征及其他严重药疹可能相似；外观相似时需要皮肤科检查，不能凭照片自行用药。
- 这些相似病的病因和治疗不同。感染后主要为口眼等黏膜炎、皮肤损伤较少的情况，尤其儿童，需要专科区分 RIME；本页不能以“感染后的皮疹”直接下 SJS 诊断。
text.en:
Not every drug rash or mouth ulcer is SJS/TEN.

- Erythema multiforme, reactive infectious mucocutaneous eruption (RIME), staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome and other severe drug eruptions can resemble it; specialist examination is needed.
- These mimics have different causes and treatment. Mucosal-predominant illness after infection, particularly in children with limited skin disease, needs specialist assessment for RIME rather than automatic SJS labeling.

text.zh-CN:
核心是停止致病暴露和多学科支持治疗。

- 医院提供个体化补液、镇痛、营养及皮肤黏膜护理；严重者需重症或烧伤团队。眼科参与处理眼部损害。
- 团队还会检查能否吞咽、呼吸和排尿；受累时分别安排气道、营养及泌尿生殖护理，不能只涂皮肤药膏。
text.en:
Stopping the culprit and multidisciplinary supportive care are central.

- Hospital care provides individualized fluids, pain relief, nutrition and skin/mucosal care; severe cases need intensive or burn care, with ophthalmology for eye involvement.
- The team also assesses swallowing, breathing and urination, arranging airway, nutrition and genitourinary care when affected; skin creams alone are insufficient.

text.zh-CN:
药物方案由专科根据病情和风险选择。

- 可能使用止痛药、局部眼药或免疫调节治疗；不同机构对全身免疫治疗的证据评价和选择不同，不能据此自行使用激素、免疫球蛋白或生物制剂。 全身糖皮质激素的获益仍有争议，临床顾虑包括感染风险；是否采用须由专科结合病程和感染情况权衡。
- 抗生素用于医生判断存在感染的情况，不是每个病例常规预防用药。
- 医生会核对并停用疑似致病药，可能同时暂时停用非必要药物；离院时应弄清需要避免的药物，并把这次反应告知今后开药的医护人员。
text.en:
Specialists select medicines according to illness and risk.

- Pain medicines, eye treatments or immune therapies may be used. Institutions differ in their assessment and choice of systemic immune treatment; these are not self-treatment options. Benefits of systemic corticosteroids remain disputed, with concerns including infection risk; specialists weigh the disease stage and infection status.
- Antibiotics are used when infection warrants them, rather than routinely for every case.
- Clinicians review and stop suspected culprit medicines and may temporarily withhold nonessential drugs. Before leaving hospital, clarify which medicines to avoid and inform future prescribers about the reaction.

text.zh-CN:
口腔损伤可能影响饮食和补液。

- 吞咽疼痛或摄入不足要告诉团队；可由营养团队调整进食方式，必要时通过管道供给营养，而不是强行进食。
- 住院补液和营养量由团队依据损失及摄入调整；吞咽恢复后逐步回到均衡饮食。没有本页推荐的“排毒”食物可以替代停致病药和支持治疗。
text.en:
Mouth injury can limit food and fluid intake.

- Tell the team about painful swallowing or inadequate intake; nutritional support may include tube feeding when needed.
- The team adjusts fluid and nutrition to losses and intake; return to a balanced diet as swallowing recovers. No detox food replaces culprit withdrawal and supportive care.

text.zh-CN:
恢复期按出院计划护理受损部位。

- 按团队指导照护皮肤、眼睛和口腔并保护新生皮肤；不要自行撕皮或采用网上的清创方法。
- 持续低落或焦虑应告诉医生或专科护士，以便安排情绪支持，不必自己硬撑。
text.en:
Follow the discharge plan while damaged surfaces recover.

- Use the prescribed skin, eye and mouth care and protect healing skin; do not peel skin or attempt online debridement methods yourself.
- Tell the doctor or specialist nurse about persistent low mood or anxiety so emotional support can be arranged.

text.zh-CN:
年龄、原有疾病和当前用药会改变照护需求。

- 儿童感染与药物都可能参与；免疫功能低下者风险较高。儿童不能照搬成人药物方案。
- 免疫抑制、肿瘤和其他器官疾病会影响住院风险评估；团队需核对所有用药及肝肾功能，不能只按照皮肤面积决定照护。
text.en:
Age, underlying illness and medicines affect care needs.

- Both infection and medicines may contribute in children; weakened immunity increases risk. Adult drug regimens should not be copied for children.
- Immunosuppression, cancer and organ disease affect risk assessment; the team reviews medicines and organ function rather than using skin area alone.

text.zh-CN:
皮肤愈合后仍可能需要持续复诊。

- 恢复可能持续数周至数月；保留眼科及其他专科复诊，持续视力、口腔或生殖泌尿问题需要继续处理。
- 长期回避致病药不等于所有药都不能用；复诊时明确哪些药禁用、有哪些替代药，并让后续开药的医生看到反应记录。
text.en:
Follow-up may continue after the skin has healed.

- Recovery may take weeks to months. Keep eye and other specialist follow-up for persistent visual, oral or genital/urinary problems.
- Avoiding a culprit does not mean avoiding every medicine; clarify prohibited and alternative medicines at follow-up and show the reaction record to future prescribers.

text.zh-CN:
风险既包括住院期也包括后遗症。

- 急性期可有脱水、感染、休克或器官损伤；以后可有眼部损伤、瘢痕及黏膜狭窄。发生这些问题不取决于皮疹看上去是否已消退。
- 眼睛或生殖泌尿黏膜的瘢痕可影响视力、排尿或日后生活；这也是急性期及时请相关专科和继续随访的原因。
text.en:
Risks include acute complications and lasting effects.

- Acute complications include dehydration, infection, shock and organ injury; later effects include eye damage, scarring and mucosal narrowing.
- Eye or genital/urinary scarring can affect vision, urination and later daily life, supporting early specialist involvement and continued follow-up.

text.zh-CN:
明确药物记录有助避免再次暴露。

- 确认致病药后长期避免该药；相关药物是否也需回避由医生明确。把药名和 SJS/TEN 反应告知所有医护，考虑携带医疗警示信息，不自行试服验证。
- 开始新药、非处方药或草药前先核对既往 SJS/TEN 记录；保留通用名和反应说明，医疗警示卡可帮助急诊迅速识别。
text.en:
Accurate medicine records help prevent re-exposure.

- Avoid the confirmed culprit long term; clinicians identify related medicines to avoid. Tell all providers the drug name and SJS/TEN reaction, consider medical identification, and do not retry it yourself.
- Check the previous SJS/TEN record before new prescription, nonprescription or herbal products. Keep generic names and the reaction description; medical identification helps emergency teams.

limitations.zh-CN: 原创简明医学信息草稿；所列来源是待逐项核对的参考依据，不表示完成系统综述、独立双源论证或医生审核。
limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
